title: Mise: cook a whole meal on one timeline
excerpt: Pick a recipe, build the rest of the menu, say when you want to eat. Mise back-schedules every dish so the whole meal lands on the table hot at once, with a shopping list and a live cooking mode. Free, no login.
content_html:
Mise· one meal, one timeline

Get dinner on the table all at once

Pick a recipe, build the menu, set the time you want to eat. Every dish is scheduled backwards from that minute, so it all lands on the table hot at once. What is Mise?

Start with a recipe

How Mise works

No login, no app, no ads in the way. More about Mise.

  1. Start from one recipe. Search any recipe on Robot Recipes. That dish anchors the meal.
  2. The robots fill in the menu. They suggest dishes that go with it and read each recipe's steps to work out how long each one takes and which parts need your hands.
  3. Say when you want to eat. Every dish is scheduled backwards from that minute, and dishes are nudged earlier so two hands-on steps never collide.
  4. Cook from the timeline. Cooking mode shows only what to do right now, keeps the screen awake and beeps when a step is due.

Cooking mode needs no connection once this page has loaded. It keeps the screen awake where the browser allows it, and beeps when a step comes due. Leave it open on the counter.
